sources.note: compileObixScript and the shared script core over the official Vue script compiler, the OBIX diagnostic vocabulary of the script stage, tests and README. No Vue source was copied or forked: @vue/compiler-sfc 3.5.43 is a dependency (pinned by obix-vue.json).

notes: The artifact is a frontend artifact (Vue's compiled script module, binding metadata and Babel AST), not the semantic authority of OBIX: the canonical DOP IR is (D-44).
The corpus is tests/corpus/vuets (pairs of byte-identical .vue / .obix fixtures); the oracle shared by the script stages is tests/vuets/oracle.mjs.
